rows.label: Death
rows.detail: Influences death and decay. Enables necromancy and withering.

rows.label: Energy
rows.detail: Influences physical forces. Enables control of fire, light, sound, gravity, speed, etc.

rows.label: Fate
rows.detail: Influences destiny and luck. Enables blessings, curses, and chance.

rows.label: Life
rows.detail: Influences vitality. Enables healing, enhancement, and control of living things.

rows.label: Mana
rows.detail: Influences magic itself. Enables spell shaping, dispels, and imbuing.

rows.label: Matter
rows.detail: Influences physical matter. Enables creation, transmutation, and destruction.

rows.label: Mind
rows.detail: Influences thoughts and emotions. Enables telepathy, illusions, and astral travel.

rows.label: Space
rows.detail: Influences distance and position. Enables scrying, portals, and teleportation.

rows.label: Spirit
rows.detail: Influences spirits. Enables summoning, banishing, and essence control.

rows.label: Time
rows.detail: Influences temporal flow. Enables foresight, time shifts, and rewinds.
